description: This Java source file defines the class OpenmrsSecurityManager, a helper subclass of SecurityManager that exposes or wraps certain security-related functionalities, notably the ability to retrieve caller class information from the call stack.

classes.name: OpenmrsSecurityManager
classes.description: A subclass of SecurityManager that provides an additional method getCallerClass to retrieve the caller class at a specified depth in the call stack, with special handling for SecurityManager classes.

methods.name: getCallerClass
methods.description: Returns the class at the specified call stack depth, adjusting for any SecurityManager classes in the call context. Throws APIException if provided a negative depth.
